item.title: Recommended Settings
item.description:
These are BayMesh’s local settings. Apply them to each radio you want to use on the community mesh, then test messages in both directions. Start with Getting Started if you haven’t paired your radio yet.

Connect to BayMesh

Setting BayMesh recommendation Why it matters
Region United States (US) Selects the regional radio band and limits.
Modem preset Medium Fast (also called Medium Range Fast) Radios need compatible modem settings to communicate.
Frequency slot 45, or 0 (automatic) with the default primary channel name Automatic selects 45 with US / Medium Fast and the default name. Set 45 explicitly if you rename the primary channel.
Primary channel name Blank Uses the default public channel name.
Primary channel key AQ== The published public key; anyone can read this channel.
OK to MQTT Enable if you want your public messages online Lets gateways share messages they hear with Discord and Meshview. Anyone on the internet can then see them.
Licensed Operator Off Use this setting for BayMesh even if you hold an amateur radio license. See Licensed Operations.

On Android, look under Settings → LoRa. On Apple devices, use Settings → Radio Configuration → LoRa. Save or send the changes and let the radio reconnect if it restarts. Menu wording can vary by app version; see the official initial setup guide.
